title: Advance
description: Marks one work package complete and lets the FSM recompute whether building continues or is done. The advance transition deletes the package's init/product/open/<id> marker; when none remain, the FSM moves to `done`.

package.description: The id of the work package now complete; must match an existing init/product/open/<id> marker.

completed_by.description: Audit identity that completed the package.

evidence.description: Optional reference to the evidence of completion (a commit, a run id, a gate verdict).
